name: @openclinxr/station-render-parity
purpose: Render-parity station entrypoint: the Blender/three.js parity capture harness (moved from the evidence parity tooling, P2e).

exportSummaries.CaptureCli: Parsed capture CLI: every flag the thin CLI forwards, with parsed --only/--rotations lists.
exportSummaries.parseCaptureArgs: Parse the capture argv into a CaptureCli, refusing unknown flags and missing required ones.
exportSummaries.resolveLevers: Resolve a lever spec to its preset name and parsed levers: inline JSON, a preset name, or a cwd-relative path.
exportSummaries.runRuntimeCapture: Run one parity capture from parsed CLI opts: beauty/calib/masks/normal-pass/dump-state capture into the out dir.
